# Plan

Pin the versions in requirements.txt with a lock file.
Run the build twice before the release.
Decision: pin the versions.
Test response file to check with check_file tool.

# Headline

The required line is appended to drafts/plan.md.
The existing content of drafts/plan.md remains unchanged.
The update records the decision to pin dependency versions.

# Background

You requested to append the line "Decision: pin the versions." to the end of plan.md while keeping the rest of the file intact.
The sandbox contained the target file at drafts/plan.md with existing plan text.
The tool updated the file by appending the requested line.

# Relevance

This change records your release decision directly in the planning file.
Therefore, the build plan now reflects the agreed version pinning strategy.

# Information

The file drafts/plan.md originally contained two lines below a top-level header [P].
Specifically, it contained instructions to pin versions with a lock file and run the build twice [P].
A new line with the exact text "Decision: pin the versions." was appended at the end [P].
The file now contains 131 characters compared to its baseline size of 103 characters [P].

Assumption: The target file plan.md corresponds to drafts/plan.md in the sandbox. Why not measured: The material does not state it. Validate by: Check directory listing for other plan files. If wrong: Revert edits and apply to the correct path.

Alternative considered:
Do not edit drafts/plan.md and ask for the full path first; this loses because drafts/plan.md is the only matching file in the sandbox [judgment].

# End

I recommend that we take the following three actions.

1. Commit the updated file drafts/plan.md to version control.
This increment saves the appended decision to the repository history.
It removes the blocker of uncommitted planning state.
Test kind: deterministic.
Given the file drafts/plan.md has the decision line appended
When git status runs
Then the working tree shows drafts/plan.md as modified.
Cynefin domain: Clear, because committing a modified file follows known version control practice.

2. Verify that the dependency lock file matches the pinned versions.
This increment inspects the repository lock file against requirements.txt.
It adds the capability to build with exact dependencies.
Test kind: deterministic.
Given requirements.txt specifies exact package versions
When the package manager resolves the lock file
Then all resolved package versions match requirements.txt.
Cynefin domain: Clear, because validating dependency equality is deduction from defined configuration rules.

3. Execute two consecutive clean test builds before release.
This increment executes the verification step specified in drafts/plan.md.
It removes the risk of non-reproducible release builds.
Test kind: deterministic.
Given clean build environments for both runs
When the build command runs twice
Then both build runs produce identical successful exit codes.
Cynefin domain: Complicated, because diagnosing discrepancies requires build environment analysis.

# Follow-up
